ambient: Something incomplete does a thing it'll do properly later, and the room approves.
A finished section is carried away by several at once.
One of the small ones follows you as far as it's allowed.
description: A wing of the structure given over to things that aren't finished. They're being worked on with enormous care and they're going to be enormous. One of them notices you, which it wasn't supposed to be able to do yet, and this is treated as very good news.
name: The Nursery

looks: They have the shape of the big ones, at a size you could hold.
One of them is further along than the others and is being watched closely.
objects.name: the unfinished ones

looks: Being made to a standard. You can see the standard from here.
It's going to do something that this room is too small for.
It stops when you look at it, out of manners, and resumes when you stop.
objects.name: the work in progress

weather: Bright, and close, and warm the way an incubator is warm.
